authoring.note: Van Baerlestraat 22-30 (even), between the Alexander Boersstraat and the Jan Luijkenstraat: the 1930 corner block 28-30 (tiled hip roof, a steep centre gable, a stone shop portal), 26 (1909, a tall bell gable, Essentiel Antwerp) and 22-24 (1909, a mansard pair over Oogappel and Reflections).

streetLevelPands.evidence: strip 2024-12-11: one pavement line under all three fronts; 3DBAG puts 28-30's ground at +0.19 m NAP against -0.84/-0.79 m for 26 and 22-24

measuredEaves.evidence: strip 2024-12-11: the white eaves boards of the side parts at row 300; the tiled hip pitched 55 deg up to the 3DBAG roof (the strip's row 182 is the set-back hip projected on the facade plane, not its height)
strip 2024-12-11: the foot of the neck gable's shoulders (top of the side wall) at row 345

notes: Floor lines read on the strip at 40 px/m: 28-30 stone ground storey to 5.15 m, sills 6.5 / 10.1 m; 26 and 22-24 shop heads 5.0 m, sills 5.8 / 9.2 m.

shopfront.evidence: strip 2024-12-11 x 0-546: a beige stone ground storey; a corner display window left, a stone portal with four lit glazed doors in timber frames and a row of small lights over them, a display window right and a dark house door at the right end; the portal lettering is not readable

roof.evidence: 3DBAG roof planes of 28-30 reach 19.3 m over the street (p95 19.28 m); the photo's brick gable has tiled cheeks running back into the hip

groundFloor.note: BAG winkelfunctie at 30; OSM node 13458209787 says shop=vacant, but the 2024-12-11 photo shows lit, stocked windows (a clothes shop); the portal lettering is not readable. Photo kept: an occupied shop, unnamed.
